meta.name: story
meta.description: 网络小说工具箱主入口。根据用户需求自动路由到对应 skill，并可管理作者习惯、启动本地 Dashboard。触发方式：/story、$story、/story dashboard、/网文、「我想写小说」「记住我的写作习惯」「打开工作台」「检查更新」。

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 说出想写的小说,自动匹配对应写作工具,并记住你的创作习惯
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果常写网络小说,想要一个统一入口来调用写作工具、沉淀习惯。
copy.tagline_en: Describe the novel you want and it picks the right writing tool and remembers your habits.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you write web fiction and want one place to run your tools and habits.

howto.what: 装上后，它会成为你写小说时的工具箱入口：按你的需求把请求分发到长篇写作、短篇写作、拆文、扫榜、去 AI 味、审稿、封面等具体技能，还能记住你的写作习惯，或启动本地工作台。
howto.when: 当你输入 /story、$story，或说「我想写小说」等时接管；如果需求模糊，它会先问你做什么，再分发到对应技能。

say.note: 它会先问长篇还是短篇，再分发

say.text: 记住我的写作习惯：我不用第一人称
say.note: 写入作者记忆，之后写作沿用
启动本地 Dashboard 并返回地址

howto.what_en: When you write fiction, this acts as the toolbox entry point: it routes your request to specific skills for long-form and short writing, breakdowns, rankings, de-AI-ifying, review, covers and more, and can remember your writing habits or start a local dashboard.
howto.when_en: It takes over when you type /story, $story or say "I want to write a novel" etc.; if the request is vague, it asks what you want first, then routes.

say_en.text: I want to write a novel
say_en.note: It asks long-form or short, then routes

say_en.text: Remember my writing habit: no first person
say_en.note: Saved to author memory, reused later
Starts the local dashboard and returns its URL
